summary.overall: The generated requirements do not cover the full source scope, several acceptance criteria are weak or non-testable, and multiple important source requirements are missing or misplaced. BDD formatting is present in many items, but compliance is inconsistent because several criteria are vague, incomplete, or not sufficiently testable.

failures.issue: No requirement explicitly covers display of current football news as a general app capability independent of personalization.
failures.source_reference: "offer football fans a central platform where they can stay comprehensively informed at all times" + "users can display current football news of their favorite teams"
failures.actionable_feedback: Add a functional requirement for news retrieval and display, including browsing current football news, filtering by team, and surfacing updates from selected channels.

failures.issue: No requirement explicitly covers extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, national and international, as a browse/search/filter capability.
failures.source_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add a requirement stating users can access content, fixtures, results, teams, and players across national and international leagues/competitions.

failures.issue: No requirement captures the notification system as a configurable module that can be activated/deactivated by the user.
failures.source_reference: "app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add a requirement for notification preferences, including enable/disable behavior, event categories, and delivery conditions.

failures.issue: No requirement covers the app's modular UI integration: modules displayed together, managed through the UI, and user configuration of additional modules.
failures.source_reference: "The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface." + "app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add one or more functional requirements for module management, configurable app sections, and UI composition/integration behavior.

failures.issue: No requirement captures that live data is retrieved via an API from an external server.
failures.source_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add a system integration requirement describing external API-based retrieval for live ticker data, including update frequency/freshness expectations if known.

failures.issue: No explicit requirement covers access to live results in real time separate from the ticker view, despite the source emphasizing real-time retrieval and display.
failures.source_reference: "give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time"
failures.actionable_feedback: Clarify whether live results are solely through the ticker or also through a dedicated live scores/results view; add a requirement accordingly.

failures.issue: No requirement addresses direct access and usability of information through the UI beyond isolated features.
failures.source_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add functional navigation requirements for direct access to news, live ticker, team/player details, streams, and notifications from the main interface.

failures.issue: Platform availability on Android and iOS is treated as a non-functional requirement, but it is primarily a product scope/platform functional constraint.
failures.source_reference: "available for Android and iOS devices"
failures.actionable_feedback: Move this to product scope or functional/platform requirements, or explicitly classify it as a platform compatibility constraint.

failures.issue: Acceptance criteria use vague wording: "within a few simple steps" is subjective and not testable.
failures.source_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
failures.actionable_feedback: Replace with measurable BDD scenarios, e.g., Given a first-time user opens the app, When they choose Register, Then they can create an account from the startup flow without navigating away from the launch sequence.

failures.issue: "No noticeable loss of performance" is vague and not testable as written.
failures.source_reference: "up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss"
failures.actionable_feedback: Define measurable thresholds in Given-When-Then form, such as response time, update latency, error rate, or success rate under 100,000 concurrent users.

failures.issue: "all major issues are found and fixed" is not objectively testable and lacks release criteria definition.
failures.source_reference: "thorough testing and support process before release"
failures.actionable_feedback: Specify measurable gates, e.g., Given pre-release testing is completed, When the release readiness report is generated, Then there are zero open severity-1 defects and no more than X severity-2 defects.

failures.issue: The acceptance criteria refer broadly to "all GDPR requirements" without defining observable system behaviors.
failures.source_reference: "processed in compliance with the GDPR"
failures.actionable_feedback: Break GDPR into testable scenarios: consent capture, privacy notice display, data deletion request handling, export request handling, and data minimization.

failures.issue: This combines multiple capabilities: following teams, selecting channels, personalized news, live results tailoring, and push notifications. This reduces independence and testability.
failures.source_reference: Derived from multiple source statements merged into one requirement.
failures.actionable_feedback: Split FR-001 into separate stories: manage favorite teams, manage preferred channels, personalize feed, and receive notifications.

failures.issue: "comprehensive statistics, biographical details, and current performance data" over-specifies content not explicitly stated in the source and may introduce unsupported scope.
failures.source_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."
failures.actionable_feedback: Limit the requirement to detailed team and player information unless the source defines the required data fields.

failures.issue: Acceptance criteria assume successful posting to a chosen social media account from within the app, which may depend on third-party authentication and installed apps. This is underspecified.
failures.source_reference: "share news and game reports via social media directly from the app"
failures.actionable_feedback: Define expected behavior more realistically: open native share sheet or provider-specific share flow; include failure handling if no target app/account is available.

failures.issue: "basic features" and "cached content" are not defined, leaving the offline requirement incomplete.
failures.source_reference: "functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline"
failures.actionable_feedback: Specify which features remain usable offline, such as viewing cached news, previously viewed team/player pages, stored preferences, and last known scores.

failures.issue: The requirement covers rights by country and live-start condition, but omits what happens before the broadcast begins.
failures.source_reference: "available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun"
failures.actionable_feedback: Add a BDD scenario: Given the match is scheduled but the live broadcast has not begun, When the user opens the match page, Then no live stream link is displayed.

failures.issue: The requirement focuses only on favorite teams, while the source also implies broad football coverage and a live ticker module as a core app function.
failures.source_reference: "live ticker module" + overall broad coverage statements
failures.actionable_feedback: Clarify whether live ticker is available only for favorites or for all matches/leagues covered by the app; add requirements accordingly.

failures.issue: Registration and login at startup are mentioned, but no scenarios cover returning users, invalid credentials, password recovery, or skipping login if applicable.
failures.source_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
failures.actionable_feedback: Add BDD scenarios for existing user login, failed login, account creation validation, and post-authentication routing.

failures.issue: No requirement addresses smooth operation beyond cold start, despite the source emphasizing quick and smooth app behavior generally.
failures.source_reference: "runs quickly and smoothly"
failures.actionable_feedback: Add performance requirements for screen transitions, feed load times, and live ticker update responsiveness.

failures.issue: No requirement covers reliability/support after release, only pre-release testing and feedback evaluation.
failures.source_reference: "testing and support process before release" could imply operational support, but the generation does not define any support behavior.
failures.actionable_feedback: Clarify whether support is internal process only or a product/service requirement; if required, define support and incident handling expectations.

reasons: Combines too many capabilities in one story, violating smallness and independence.
Does not separately define notifications as an activated function.
Acceptance criteria only show one positive path and omit editing/removing preferences and disabling notifications.
Captures live ticker concept, but only for favorite teams.
Omits explicit external API integration and continuous update behavior through the UI.
Acceptance criteria do not define what 'real-time' means.
Covers team/player information broadly.
Adds unsupported specificity about statistics/biographical/current performance data.
Does not explicitly tie to coverage of all competitions beyond a generic statement.
Good core rights/country coverage.
Missing scenario for pre-live state.
No behavior specified for unavailable provider link or provider launch failure.
Captures social sharing intent.
Acceptance criteria are optimistic and not robust for third-party dependencies.
No scenario for game reports specifically, only news articles.
Vague, non-testable acceptance criteria.
Insufficient scope coverage for authentication flows.
Does not define what startup-integrated login/registration means behaviorally.
Covers platform availability.
Likely misclassified as non-functional.
Directly traceable and measurable.
BDD structure is adequate.
Uses subjective wording.
No measurable performance benchmark beyond concurrency count.
Captures degraded/offline intent.
Fails to define minimum offline feature set.
Traceable to the source.
Ambiguous whether this is a user-facing requirement or architectural constraint.
Needs clearer definition of what kinds of updates must not alter UI/module consistency.
Process-oriented and partially outside product requirement scope.
Acceptance criteria are not measurable enough.
Traceable to GDPR source requirement.
Acceptance criteria too broad to be verifiable as written.

recommended_additions.title: Football news browsing and display
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given current football news is available, When the user opens the news section, Then the app displays the latest football news items and allows filtering by followed teams and selected channels.

recommended_additions.title: League and competition coverage
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given the app supports multiple competitions, When the user browses leagues and tournaments, Then they can access national and international competitions and view related teams, players, fixtures, and results.

recommended_additions.title: Notification settings management
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given the user is in notification settings, When they enable notifications for followed teams, Then the app sends notifications for relevant news and match events; And Given they disable notifications, When new events occur, Then no push notification is sent.

recommended_additions.title: Module configuration and UI integration
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given configurable modules are available, When the user adds, removes, or reorders modules in the app interface, Then the selected modules are displayed through the main user interface according to the saved configuration.

recommended_additions.title: External live-data API integration
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given a live match is in progress and the external live-data API is reachable, When the live ticker requests match updates, Then the app retrieves and displays the latest live data from the external server.

recommended_additions.title: Offline usable feature definition
recommended_additions.suggested_bdd: Given the device is offline, When the user opens previously viewed news, team pages, or saved preferences, Then the app displays the last cached version and remains responsive.
